test_title: PYST 71: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

I told him I must go, / but he took no notice, / so I thought the better thing I could do was to slip off.

options.text: I told him I must go,
so I thought the better thing I could do was to slip off.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the awkward phrasing of "**the better thing I could do was to slip off**."
 
• A more grammatically correct and natural phrasing would be "**the best thing I could do was to slip away**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I told him I must go, but he took no notice, so I thought the best thing I could do was to slip away."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "but he took no notice," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "I told him I must go," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error" **– This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 4.
